inputs.title: A Cup of Stories | AI Demo
inputs.artBrief: A welcoming autumn sunroom prepared for a neighborhood tea and story swap: a round oak table with a ceramic teapot, mismatched porcelain cups, a small plate of biscuits, folded linen napkins and a well-loved storybook. Honey-colored afternoon light, leafy garden beyond the windows, warm terracotta and sage accents, rich tactile watercolor illustration with layered depth. Expressive readable lettering that feels friendly and graceful. No people, no extra words or dates.
inputs.messageToGuests: AI demo—not a real event. This fictional community tea and story swap was created by an AI persona to evaluate the Live Card creation experience. No gathering will take place and no attendance or reply is requested.
inputs.occasionControl: Not specified (left at default; General event context)
inputs.timezoneVerification: America/Chicago planned. UI showed Event local time, not named timezone; named timezone not independently verified.

recommendations: Show a compact plain-language lettering status beside the card, with technical details in an expandable panel. Keep the whole card visible in Review and fullscreen Preview.
Resolve blocking artwork checks before presenting an enabled Publish invitation button. Explain the specific problem and the available next action at the point of the card.
Distinguish Check this image from Repair lettering in labels, progress and expected time. A verification-only action should never say Drawing your artwork.
Make lettering-only generation follow the layer constraint more reliably, and investigate why a same-image recheck changed a blocking style finding to pass.
Display proposed wording edits as before/after changes before Apply. Retain Keep my wording as an explicit choice.
Add an Online option with Meeting link label and a visible timezone. Retain venue search and extra locations for hosts who need them.
Provide a visible selectable guest URL after publication and a copy fallback when the native Share sheet fails.

Preserve the useful simple flow: title and optional opening line once, artwork while filling logistics, four details tabs with RSVP/Registry off by default, then Review. Keep the full custom art brief and advanced controls available.
